body:
Around 9 pm last night I took 400 mg of lyrica and smoked a few blunts. I heard it should kick in about an hour. But by 10 I didn't feel a thing. I got inpatient and took another 200 mg. I watched a movie, and did I few chores, but with a strange sense of.. Ambition almost. Like I HAD to scrub the fridge. I have bipolar, and go off my meds when trying other drugs, in attempt to not effect the results, but I was physically unable to stop moving. I would sit down, and stand up immediately. It is now 5 am and I am unable to sleep, typing is helping with my pent up energy. I think I found the answer to all-night study sessions for the fall semester.
